text:
TAQAT AL-YOUM AL-'AMMAH
Tatamayaz yawm 3 Nofimbir 2026 bi-taqa hayawiyyah wa mushtali'ah lil-jawza', hayth tastaqbil al-falak bi-nshat zihnni qawi yaj'aluka taqdir 'ala tawjeeh omourak bi-daka'. Al-jaww al-'amm yumtal'u bil-ibda' wa al-furs al-jadidah allati tantathir minka al-mubadarah wa al-tajarud min al-taraddud. Ruhuka al-muminah bi-al-taghyir satakoun hiya al-mouharrik al-asasi li-kull khoutwa takhtouha al-yawm, fa 'ish hadha al-ywm bi-kull shaghaf wa la tada' ayy taqa salbiyyah tutbi' 'ala mizajaka al-mashreq.

AL-HUBB WA AL-ALAQAT
Lil-murtabiteen, hadha al-ywm yumthil fursah thahabiyyah li-ta'zeez al-tawassul al-'atifiyyah ma' al-shareek 'abr hiwar 'ameeq wa sadiq yuzil ayy سوء_فاهم سabeq. Innaha lahdah munasibah jiddan li-i'adat al-hararah li-al-'alaqah 'abr mufaja'ah basita aw qada' waqt mumta' ba'eedan 'an dawdhat al-haya' al-yawmiyyah. Amma lil-'uzzab, fa al-falk yuhammil laka bisharat bi-liqaa' ghayr mutawaqqa' qad yughayir majra qalbika wa yaj'aluka tasta'id li-bidayah 'atifiyyah jadidah mali'ah bi-al-romانسiyyah wa al-tafahum al-mutabaadallah.

AL-AMAL WA AL-MAHAARAH
Fi majal al-'amal, tatamayaz al-yawm bi-qudratika al-fareedah 'ala idarat al-matha'ir al-muta'addidah bi-kafa'ah 'aliyah tunthir bi-injazat kabirah. Qad tataqallaq farsha muhimmah li-tawsee' shabakat 'alaqatika al-mihniyyah aw taqdeem mashroo' ibda'iyy yanal i'jab al-ru'asaa' wa al-zumalaa'. Ihdhar faqat min al-tasarruf al-saree' aw al-ishtighal bi-akthar min muhimmah fi nafs al-waqt hatta la tufqid al-turkez al-lathi yuhmi najaahaka.

AL-MAL WA AL-BARAKAH
Al-wad' al-madi yashhad istiqraru malhousouban ma' imkaniyyat husoul 'ala makasib ghayr muntatharah aw taswiyah li-amr mali qadeem kan yushghal balaka. Raghm dhalik, al-falk yansahaka bi-al-ta'anni qabla 'amal ayy shira' kabir aw istithmar jadid al-yawm. Kun ða wa'y fi tawzee' amwalika wa aj'al al-awlawiyyah lil-mashrou'at al-mustaqbaliyyah allati tudammir laka barakah wa istiqrarun dawim.

AL-SIHHA WA AL-TAQA
Sihhatuka al-badaniyyah wa al-nafsiyyah fi afdal halatha bi-shart an tu'ti nafsaka waqtan lil-raha wa al-istirkha' ba'd fatrat al-nashat al-makaththafah. Unsahaka bi-mumarasat ba'd tamarin al-yoga aw al-mashy fi al-hawa' al-taliq li-tafrigh al-shuhunat al-salbiyyah wa ta'zeez al-taqa al-ijabiyyah dakhil jasadaka. Ihtam bi-shurb al-maa' bi-katrah wa tanawwul al-aghdhiyah al-sihhiyyah li-muhafazah 'ala hayawiyyatika al-yawmiyyah.

AL-TAWASSUL WA AL-MUHIT
Al-hayat al-ijtima'iyyah muta'alliqah jiddan al-yawm, fa anta mahatt anthan al-jamia' bi-sabab wada'atika wa qudratika al-riadiyyah 'ala al-hiwar. Furssah ra'i'ah li-ltawasul ma' al-asdiqa' al-qudamaa' aw mugarabat afrad al-a'ilah al-lazina tafqaduhum bi-sabab al-inshighal al-mustamirr. Sawtuka sayakoun masdaran lil-ilham wa al-da'm li-man hawlaka, fa la takhshif 'an taqdeem al-nasiha al-sadiqa.

NASIHAT AL-YOUM
La tad' al-tafasir al-saghirah tudayyi' 'alaika jamal al-surah al-kabirah; kun murinan wa itruk al-umur tasir bi-insiabyyatha al-tabi'iyyah.

TAFASIL AL-YOUM
Al-raqm al-mahzouz: 5
Al-lawn al-mahzouz: Al-Asfar al-Mishriq
Al-burj al-mutawafiq: Al-Meezan
